entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I received a few weeks ago. I need to process a return for a helmet I purchased.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Got it. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet, delivered 26 days ago. What seems to be the issue with it?
Oh, there's no issue with the helmet itself, the color just wasn't what I expected from the pictures online. I haven't even taken it out of the packaging; the box unopened and everything.

I understand completely. Sometimes the screen doesn't do the real-life color justice. Let me just check our return policy... yes, it looks like you are well within the 90-day return window. I can go ahead and approve that return for you right now.

That's great, thank you. Now, since I'll have to pay to ship it back and it's in perfect, unused condition, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase? I'm planning to order the same helmet in a different color.

I appreciate you asking, but I'm afraid our system doesn't allow for discount codes on return transactions. However, once we process your refund, you can apply it toward the new helmet. We definitely want to make sure you get gear you're happy with; a proper fit and feel is a key part of rider safety.
I see. Well, no harm in asking. Please go ahead and start the return process.

Of course. I've just sent the return authorization and shipping label to the email on file. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and you'll be all set. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
